description: Upload the project's changed files to its web server. Runs the configured build first. Use dryRun to preview, delete to remove stale remote files, commit to git-commit before deploying. The result says whether the site verified as live; only call it live when verify.ok is true. Previous versions of changed files stay on the server so coolftp_undo can revert.

commit.description: git add -A && git commit before deploying

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the COOLFTP_PROJECT setting, else the MCP server working directory.

delete.description: Delete remote files that no longer exist locally

deleteUntracked.description: Only with delete on a first deploy: also remove remote files coolFTP never uploaded. Ask the user before setting this.

message.description: Short note stored with the deploy (and used as the commit message with commit=true)

site.description: Site name. Defaults to the site in the nearest .coolftp.json, or the only saved site.

name: coolftp_deploy
